info.title: HFS built-in authorization server — admin API
info.description: Manage internal authorization servers (realms): settings, signing keys, apps, users, sessions, grants, EHR launches, endpoint binding, and the diagnostic. Requires an administrator (console session with role admin + X-CSRF-Token for writes, the administrator credential, or an admin token). Available only with HFS_IDP=on. Exception: a user's resource access in bulk (/users/{user}/links) needs only the viewer role to read and editor to change, as in the console.

field.description: Field the error belongs to (e.g. lifetimes.accessToken, redirectUris)

RealmSpec.description: helios_idp::realm::RealmSpec (camelCase): name, displayName, enabled, userSource{kind:local|console}, signingAlgs[RS256|RS384|PS256|PS384|ES256|ES384], rsaBits, rotation{rotateAfterDays,prepublishHours,retainHours}, lifetimes{…}, features{launchEhr,launchStandalone,clientPublic,…}, security{…}, endpoints[], branding

ClientSpec.description: helios_idp::client::ClientSpec (camelCase): clientId, name, auth{method:none|client_secret|private_key_jwt,…}, grantTypes, redirectUris, launchTypes[ehr|standalone|backend], scopes{allowed[],acceptV1}, trusted, disabled

RealmUser.description: helios_idp::user::RealmUser: id, username, kind[patient|practitioner|related-person|staff], displayName, email, links[{endpoint,reference,isFhirUser,accessiblePatients}], disabled

app.description: Also check that this registered app is accepted with this redirect URI

patient.description: Link the test user to Patient/{id} on the first bound endpoint and use patient scopes

code.description: Stable message code (console catalog idpdiag-<code>, idpdiag-<code>-fix)

field.description: Console field to fix (Go to field)

AccessEntry.description: One granted reference. kind fhirUser = the user is this resource on the endpoint (at most one per endpoint); patient = a Patient the user may select (stored in the fhirUser link's accessiblePatients); link = another linked resource.

fingerprint.description: Same as the ETag; send it as If-Match

AccessResult.description: Applied change (or, with dryRun=true or on 422, the plan: rows, counts per status new|granted|changed|invalid|duplicate|conflict, the first 500 rejected rows with line, input, issue code and message).
